headline: Software, Systems & Applied AI.
description: Krishirajsinh Puwar studies Information Engineering at the Technical University of Munich. Explore his work in platform engineering, software, and applied AI.
intro: I study Information Engineering at the Technical University of Munich. I’ve worked in platform engineering at Schwarz IT, tested software and curriculum at Arkadia, and tutored students in computer networking and IT security at TUM.
